data.name: Hitarth
data.gender_notes: Hitarth is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who possesses the qualities of a warrior, having the courage and strength to face challenges with wisdom. The name Hitarth carries the meaning “Having Valor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Hitarth usually hope their child will grow to embody having valor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to a person who embodies the qualities of a warrior, having the courage and strength to face spiritual challenges with wisdom and inner power.
data.etymology: Hitarth belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Having Valor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hitarth total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
